label: October 12–18, 2026
intro: Final days of the Vegetarian Festival + October school break kicks in — a great week for a Klook adventure day!
weekday_note: With school break starting, weekday venues like the planetarium and science museum are easier to visit before the weekend rush.

activities.title: Vegetarian Festival Closing Weekend — Yaowarat
activities.location: Yaowarat Road, Chinatown, Bangkok (MRT Hua Lamphong or Wat Mangkon)
activities.why: Final nights are often the liveliest — processions, ceremonial events, and the street food stalls are at full swing. If you missed the opening weekend, don't miss this!
activities.tip: Oct 18 is the last night. Arrive early for a spot near the main temple areas. Take MRT to Hua Lamphong or Wat Mangkon — parking near Yaowarat is a nightmare.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: The Marvel Experience Thailand, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (~35 min by Grab from central BKK)
activities.why: Iron Man, Thor, Captain America — 20+ Marvel heroes in a massive 4D experience dome. This is the definitive Bangkok superhero outing for a 5-year-old obsessed with Iron Man.
activities.tip: Pre-book on Klook to save and skip queues. Go on a weekday if possible during school break — less crowded than weekends. Grab car from Sukhumvit ~250 THB each way.

activities.title: Rollerblading at Roller Dome — Emporium
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.why: Great time to go during school break — the rink runs weekend specials and Thor can sharpen his rollerblading skills with the in-house instructors.
activities.tip: If Thor has been once before, see if he's ready to skate without the wall! Coaches are available for one-on-one sessions.

activities.title: Bangkok Planetarium — Science Center for Education
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit (near BTS Ekkamai)
activities.price: Museum free / Planetarium: ~30–50 THB kids, ~50 THB adults
activities.why: The 360-degree star dome is genuinely awe-inspiring for a 5-year-old — combines perfectly with his curiosity about space and Iron Man flying through the sky.
activities.tip: Tuesday English shows only. Go during school break on a Tuesday to beat the usual weekend school groups. Pirate ship and insect exhibits are kid favourites.

activities.title: Cooking Workshop for Kids — Silom Cooking School (Little Chef)
activities.location: Silom / Sathorn area (check current location at booking)
activities.why: Thor the little chef — hands-on cooking workshop where kids make Thai dishes and desserts from scratch. Great for his building & making energy when it needs a kitchen channel.
activities.tip: Book in advance via their website or ClassBento. October school break sessions fill fast — book by end of September.
